get.description: Retrieves extended ASN details from BigDataCloud.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: asn
parameters.description: Autonomous System Number as numeric or ASN format, for example 123, AS123, or ASN123.

schema.description: Autonomous System Number as numeric or ASN format, for example 123, AS123, or ASN123.

parameters.name: localityLanguage
parameters.description: Preferred language for localized place and country names.

schema.description: Preferred language for localized place and country names.

parameters.name: peersCap
parameters.description: Maximum number of receivingFrom and transitTo entries to retrieve. Default and hard limit are 50.

schema.description: Maximum number of receivingFrom and transitTo entries to retrieve. Default and hard limit are 50.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

confidenceArea.description: Most active geographical area detected for the ASN.

rank.description: Global rank by total number of announced IP addresses.

receivingFrom.description: Active Autonomous Systems sending traffic to this ASN.

registry.description: Regional Internet Registry the ASN is registered with.

totalIpv4Addresses.description: Total number of IPv4 addresses announced by the ASN.

totalIpv4BogonPrefixes.description: Total number of IPv4 bogon prefixes announced by the ASN.

totalIpv4Prefixes.description: Total number of IPv4 BGP prefixes announced by the ASN.

totalIpv6BogonPrefixes.description: Total number of IPv6 bogon prefixes announced by the ASN.

totalIpv6Prefixes.description: Total number of IPv6 BGP prefixes announced by the ASN.

totalReceivingFrom.description: Total number of active Autonomous Systems sending traffic to this ASN.

totalTransitTo.description: Total number of active Autonomous Systems receiving traffic from this ASN.

transitTo.description: Active Autonomous Systems receiving traffic from this ASN.

get.summary: Get IP Geolocation with Confidence Area
get.description: Retrieves IP geolocation with confidence area details from BigDataCloud.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address. If omitted, the caller IP address is assumed.

schema.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address. If omitted, the caller IP address is assumed.

parameters.name: localityLanguage
parameters.description: Preferred language for locality names in ISO 639-1 format.

schema.description: Preferred language for locality names in ISO 639-1 format.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

confidenceArea.description: Closed polygon representing the estimated confidence area.

country.description: Country details for the geolocated IP address.

ip.description: Requested IP address in string format.

isReachableGlobally.description: Whether the IP address is reachable on the global routing table.

lastUpdated.description: Time when this IP address geolocation was last assessed.

localityLanguageRequested.description: Locality language request value used for the response.

location.description: Estimated geolocation details for the IP address.

network.description: Network details for the IP address.
